Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ يَحْجُبُنِيْ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِكَ خِلَالٌ ثَلَاثٌ
Translation: O Allah, three qualities prevent me from asking You

Arabic text: وَتَحْدُونِيْ عَلَيْهَا خَلَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
Translation: And one quality urges me towards it

Arabic text: يَحْجُبُنِيْ أَمْرٌ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ فَأَبْطَأْتُ عَنْهُ
Translation: I am prevented by commands You ordered which I was slow to fulfill

Arabic text: وَنَهْيٌ نَهَيْتَنِيْ عَنْهُ فَأَسْرَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And prohibitions You forbade which I hastened to commit

Arabic text: وَنِعْمَةٌ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ فَقَصَّرْتُ فِيْ شُكْرِهَا
Translation: And blessings You bestowed upon me for which I was deficient in gratitude

Arabic text: وَيَحْدُونِيْ عَلَى مَسْأَلَتِكَ تَفَضُّلُكَ
Translation: And what urges me to ask You is Your favor

Arabic text: عَلَى مَنْ أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Upon those who turn their faces toward You

Arabic text: وَوَفَدَ بِحُسْنِ ظَنِّهِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And approach You with good expectations

Arabic text: إِذْ جَمِيعُ إِحْسَانِكَ تَفَضُّلٌ
Translation: Since all Your benevolence is a favor

Arabic text: وَإِذْ كُلُّ نِعَمِكَ ابْتِدَاءٌ
Translation: And all Your blessings are initiated by You

Arabic text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا يَا إِلَهِيْ وَاقِفٌ بِبَابِ عِزِّكَ
Translation: So here I am, my God, standing at the door of Your might

Arabic text: وُقُوفَ الْمُسْتَسْلِمِ الذَّلِيلِ، وَسَائِلُكَ عَلَى الْحَيَاءِ مِنِّي
Translation: Standing as one surrendered and humbled, asking You despite my embarrassment

Arabic text: سُؤَالَ الْبَائِسِ الْمُعِيلِ مُقِرٌّ لَكَ بِأَنِّي
Translation: Like the asking of a destitute, acknowledging that I

Arabic text: لَمْ أَسْتَسْلِمْ وَقْتَ إِحْسَانِكَ إِلَّا بِالْإِقْلَاعِ عَنْ عِصْيَانِكَ
Translation: Did not surrender during Your benevolence except by ceasing my disobedience to You

Arabic text: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ فِيْ الْحَالَاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنِ امْتِنَانِكَ
Translation: And I was never free in all situations from Your favors

Arabic text: فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُنِيْ يَا إِلَهِيْ إِقْرَارِيْ عِنْدَكَ بِسُوءِ مَا اكْتَسَبْتُ
Translation: So will it benefit me, my God, to confess before You the evil I have earned?

Arabic text: وَهَلْ يُنْجِينِيْ مِنْكَ اعْتِرَاْفِيْ لَكَ بِقَبِيحِ مَا ارْتَكَبْتُ
Translation: Will my confession to You of the ugliness of what I have committed save me from You?

Arabic text: أَمْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِيْ فِيْ مَقَامِيْ هَذَا سُخْطَكَ
Translation: Have You decreed Your displeasure for me in this position of mine?

Arabic text: أَمْ لَزِمَنِيْ فِيْ وَقْتِ دُعَايَ مَقْتُكَ
Translation: Or has Your abhorrence become necessary for me at the time of my supplication?

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا أَيْأَسُ مِنْكَ وَقَدْ فَتَحْتَ لِيْ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! I do not despair of You when You have opened for me the door of repentance

Arabic text: بَلْ أَقُولُ مَقَالَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ الظَّالِمِ لِنَفْسِهِ
Translation: Rather, I speak as a humble servant who has wronged himself

Arabic text: اَلْمُسْتَخِفِّ بِحُرْمَةِ رَبِّهِ
Translation: Who has taken lightly the sanctity of his Lord

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ فَجَلَّتْ وَأَدْبَرَتْ أَيَّامُهُ فَوَلَّتْ
Translation: Whose sins have become great and grave, and whose days have turned away and gone

Arabic text: حَتَّى إِذَا رَأَى مُدَّةَ الْعَمَلِ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
Translation: Until when he sees that the period of action has expired

Arabic text: وَغَايَةَ الْعُمُرِ قَدِ انْتَهَتْ
Translation: And the end of life has arrived

Arabic text: وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ لَا مَحِيصَ لَهُ مِنْكَ وَلَا مَهْرَبَ لَهُ عَنْكَ
Translation: And he is certain that he has no escape from You and no place to flee from You

Arabic text: تَلَقَّاكَ بِالْإِنَابَةِ وَأَخْلَصَ لَكَ التَّوْبَةَ
Translation: He turns to You in repentance and purifies his repentance for You

Arabic text: فَقَامَ إِلَيْكَ بِقَلْبٍ طَاهِرٍ نَقِيٍّ
Translation: So he stands before You with a pure, clean heart

Arabic text: ثُمَّ دَعَاكَ بِصَوْتٍ حَائِلٍ خَفِيٍّ
Translation: Then he calls You with a faint, low voice

Arabic text: قَدْ تَطَأْطَأَ لَكَ فَانْحَنَى وَنَكَّسَ رَأْسَهُ فَانْثَنَى
Translation: He has bowed his head before You and bent, and lowered his head and curved

Arabic text: قَدْ أَرْعَشَتْ خَشْيَتُهُ رِجْلَيْهِ وَغَرَّقَتْ دُمُوعُهُ خَدَّيْهِ
Translation: His fear has made his legs tremble and his tears have soaked his cheeks

Arabic text: يَدْعُوكَ بِيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ انْتَابَهُ الْمُسْتَرْحِمُوْنَ
Translation: He calls upon You: "O Most Merciful of the merciful! O Most Merciful to those who seek mercy!

Arabic text: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ أَطَافَ بِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ
Translation: O Most Kind to those who seek forgiveness!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ عَفْوُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ نَقِمَتِهِ
Translation: O One whose pardon is greater than His vengeance!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ رِضَاهُ أَوْفَرُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ
Translation: O One whose pleasure is more abundant than His anger!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إِلَى خَلْقِهِ بِحُسْنِ التَّجَاوُزِ
Translation: O One who has earned praise from His creation through His beautiful forgiveness!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبَادَهُ قَبُولَ الْإِنَابَةِ
Translation: O One who has accustomed His servants to the acceptance of repentance!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنِ اسْتَصْلَحَ فَاسِدَهُمْ بِالتَّوْبَةِ
Translation: O One who reforms their corruption through repentance!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ رَضِيَ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ بِالْيَسِيرِ
Translation: O One who is satisfied with the small from their actions!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ كَافَى قَلِيلَهُمْ بِالْكَثِيرِ
Translation: O One who rewards their little with much!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ ضَمِنَ لَهُمْ إِجَابَةَ الدُّعَاءِ
Translation: O One who has guaranteed them the answer to their prayers!

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ وَعَدَهُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِتَفَضُّلِهِ حُسْنَ الْجَزَاءِ
Translation: O One who has promised them, by His grace, an excellent reward!

Arabic text: مَا أَنَا بِأَعْصَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ
Translation: I am not more disobedient than those who disobeyed You and You forgave them

Arabic text: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَلْوَمِ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إِلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُ
Translation: I am not more blameworthy than those who apologized to You and You accepted from them

Arabic text: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَظْلَمِ مَنْ تَابَ إِلَيْكَ فَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: I am not more unjust than those who repented to You and You turned to them

Arabic text: أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ مَقَامِيْ هَذَا تَوْبَةَ نَادِمٍ عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْهُ
Translation: I repent to You in this position of mine with the repentance of one regretful for what escaped from him

Arabic text: مُشْفِقٍ مِمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ خَالِصِ الْحَيَاءِ مِمَّا وَقَعَ فِيهِ
Translation: Fearful of what has accumulated upon him, with sincere shame for what has befallen him

Arabic text: عَالِمٍ بِأَنَّ الْعَفْوَ عَنِ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا يَتَعَاظَمُكَ
Translation: Knowing that pardoning great sin is not difficult for You

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ التَّجَاوُزَ عَنِ الْإِثْمِ الْجَلِيلِ لَا يَسْتَصْعِبُكَ
Translation: And that overlooking enormous transgression is not hard for You

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ احْتِمَالَ الْجِنَايَاتِ الْفَاحِشَةِ لَا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ
Translation: And that bearing terrible offenses does not burden You

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ عِبَادِكَ إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الْإِسْتِكْبَارَ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: And that the most beloved of Your servants to You is he who abandons arrogance toward You

Arabic text: وَجَانَبَ الْإِصْرَارَ وَلَزِمَ الَاسْتِغْفَارَ
Translation: Who avoids persistence in sin and adheres to seeking forgiveness

Arabic text: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَسْتَكْبِرَ
Translation: I declare myself free before You from being arrogant

Arabic text: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُصِرَّ
Translation: I seek refuge in You from persisting in sin

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا قَصَّرْتُ فِيهِ
Translation: I seek Your forgiveness for what I have fallen short in

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ
Translation: I seek Your help with what I am unable to do

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيْ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ
Translation: And grant me what is obligatory upon me toward You

Arabic text: وَعَافِنِيْ مِمَّا أَسْتَوْجِبُهُ مِنْكَ
Translation: And protect me from what I deserve from You

Arabic text: وَأَجِرْنِيْ مِمَّا يَخَافُهُ أَهْلُ الْإِسَاءَةِ
Translation: And save me from what the people of evil fear

Arabic text: فَإِنَّكَ مَلِيءٌ بِالْعَفْوِ مَرْجُوٌّ لِلْمَغْفِرَةِ مَعْرُوفٌ بِالتَّجَاوُزِ
Translation: For You are full of pardon, hoped for forgiveness, known for overlooking

Arabic text: لَيْسَ لِحَاجَتِيْ مَطْلَبٌ سِوَاكَ
Translation: There is no place to seek my need except with You

Arabic text: وَلَا لِذَنْبِيْ غَافِرٌ غَيْرُكَ حَاشَاكَ
Translation: And there is no forgiver for my sin other than You, far be it from You

Arabic text: وَلَا أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ إِلَّا إِيَّاكَ
Translation: And I fear none for myself except You

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
Translation: You are worthy of being feared and worthy of forgiving

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَاقْضِ حَاجَتِيْ وَأَنْجِحْ طَلِبَتِي
Translation: And fulfill my need and grant my request

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ ذَنْبِيْ وَ آمِنْ خَوْفَ نَفْسِي
Translation: And forgive my sin and secure me from the fear of myself

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: Indeed, You have power over all things

Arabic text: وَذَلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ آمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And that is easy for You. Amen, Lord of the worlds
